messages:
Maya Singh: Heads-up 1 CedarAx XP EAP kickoff. Partner signed NDA this morning (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/CEDARAX-NDA). Need to finalize bench matrix, SI integration points, marketplace preview copy, and embargo window by EOD Thu.
conrad_ops: Got it. Can partner provide kernel+firmware images by Tue so we can validate our custom kernel patches?
Zoe Park: We'll run a two-track validation: 1) infra compatibility (networking, drivers) 2) perf matrix (latency, throughput, cold starts). Minimal perf gates for preview: rwd-13b p50 < 68ms, p95 < 260ms @8k.
Legal Bot: NDA status: executed. Partner requested a 10-day mutual embargo after internal approval. Recommend we don't commit public dates until bench artifacts + legal sign-off.
Marketplace Team: For the preview listing, partner wants a partner badge + "preview" label. We'll avoid any GA phrasing and remove pricing claims. Draft will be uploaded to /drive/marketplace/cedarax/preview-v1.md.
Maya Singh: SI note: CedarAx's SI (BlueRiver) wants a short-run integration test for our deployment manifest and a sample terraform module. They asked for access to our private terraform templates. Can we share a sanitized subset?
conrad_ops: We can share a sanitized template (no secrets). I'll prepare `tf/cedarax-eap-sample.tf` and drop to the drive. Also need to add a runtime fallback path in case of thermal throttling.
Zoe Park: Bench matrix proposal: models=[rwd-13b,rwd-70b], ctx=[4k,8k,32k], modes=[fp16,quant8]. Include sustained 1h QPS sweep to catch thermal/thermal-throttle regressions. Also capture cold-start p95.
Bench Lab: Reserved bench slots: Fri 23:00-03:00 UTC and Sat 04:00-08:00 UTC. Please upload bench configs to https://drive.redwood/apps/cedarax/eap-configs. Job queued id=CX-EAP-7702. Logs at /runs/CX-EAP-7702.
conrad_ops: Runtime fallback snippet to add: `{"fallback_policy":"cedarax-quant-fallback","throttle_monitoring":true}`. Also add metrics tag: `cedarax-xp-eap`.
Zoe Park: Telemetry plan: 0.75% token sampling, prefix cache hit/miss, per-request cold-start marker, anonymize prompts. We'll attach flamegraphs + heatmaps. Legal Bot: telemetry plan OK if prompts are removed.
Maya Singh: Partner asked for joint PR talking points: emphasize "preview" availability, performance snapshot, and SI integration story with BlueRiver. We'll coordinate messaging after successful artifacts upload.
Marketplace Team: We'll need a screenshot of the console integration (no customer data). BlueRiver, please provide a placeholder screenshot or we will use a mocked UI.
conrad_ops: I'll create the sanitized terraform + mocked console screenshot. Dropping to drive: /drive/marketplace/cedarax/assets.
Zoe Park: Command for dev bench: `./bench/run --target cedarax-xp --model rwd-13b --ctx 8192 --mode fp16 --warmup 700 --samples 200 --cold-start`
Bench Lab: Please note: include environmental sensors in the run (board temp) to correlate thermal events. We'll attach sensor logs to artifacts.
deploy-bot: bench-run queued: job_id=CX-EAP-7702, eta Fri 23:00 UTC. Artifacts will appear under /runs/CX-EAP-7702.
Maya Singh: Action items recap: Zoe run bench + upload artifacts (Due: Sat EOD), conrad prepare sanitized terraform + fallback (Due: Thu EOD), Marketplace finalize preview copy + assets (Due: Fri). Sync Thu 09:00 PT to confirm readiness. Ping here if images/firmware delayed. :rocket:
